limitations: All94 contribute to accuracy and question-average cost. Only92 have at least2 matched rounds, so only92 contribute to observed repeatability;86 have all3 rounds. Missing rounds are never imputed.
Cost quantiles describe available-round question means, not individual execution quantiles. Range-fold compares maximum/minimum across2 or3 observed rounds; it is not a2-run statistic.
Pairwise repeat metrics average all distinct pairs within question, then average questions. The extra pair count of3-run questions does not triple their weight.

H/new cohorts have real protocol and time differences, so observed cross-round fluctuation is not pure stochastic noise. Condition effects, protocol drift and stochastic variation cannot be fully separated.
Intervals are descriptive paired-question bootstrap intervals and do not model a shared provider/batch shift. Multiple distribution diagnostics were exploratory.
Native labels preserved; q5/q13 exclusion is an existing sensitivity, not scorer repair. Any worsening is reported as an observed result.
Noise-adjusted paired second moments assume stationary independent contrast replicates. Nonpositive estimates are not clipped and are not proof of absent effects.
